prompt.description: English description (see server instructions). Optional for sfx when the sound_* fields are given.

audio_type.description: music = BGM / full instrumental track; instrument = solo instrument, stem or loop; sfx = sound effect, ambience or one-shot; raw = no prefix (prompt used verbatim)

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds. Default: music 60, instrument 12, sfx 5, raw 30.

variations.description: Number of candidates (different seeds) to generate in one call.

bpm.description: Tempo for music/instrument; appended as 'BPM: N.'

sound_source.description: SFX: what makes the sound (object, instrument, creature, machine).

sound_action.description: SFX: how it is triggered and evolves over time (attack, decay, movement).

sound_space.description: SFX: space and recording (indoor/outdoor, distance, dry/reverberant, mic).

seed.description: Base seed for reproducibility; omit or -1 for random.

negative_prompt.description: Qualities to avoid. Only takes effect when cfg != 1.

cfg.description: Guidance. 1.0 = official default; 3–7 = stricter prompt adherence (≈2× slower).

steps.description: Sampling steps; 8 is the official default.

title.description: Short name; used as the file name and stored in metadata. Auto-named if omitted.

original_idea.description: The user's original request, verbatim and in their language. Stored in metadata only.

peak_ceiling_db.description: Safety ceiling in dBFS: a louder peak is turned down to this, quieter audio is untouched. null disables.
